INSERT INTO receply_message_log (account_id, conversation_id, channel, sender_phone, customer_message, ai_response, is_error)
VALUES (CASE WHEN $1 ~ '^\d+$' THEN $1::int END, CASE WHEN $2 ~ '^\d+$' THEN $2::int END, NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, ''), $5, $6, $7::boolean)
